subject.title: fix: show readable session names across Windows UX

question: Should Windows adopt Gateway-classified background-session hiding by default across the Sessions page, chat picker, tray menu, and dashboard as part of the coordinated presentation-contract rollout?
rationale: Readable titles are well supported, but the PR also intentionally removes background sessions from several existing navigation surfaces and depends on an upstream contract that remains open; automated review cannot choose that product and compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve the coordinated rollout
options.body: Finalize the upstream contract, capture native Windows proof for new and older Gateways, and land the readable-title and default background-filtering behavior together.

options.title: Land readable names only
options.body: Keep the presentation resolver and localization but defer cross-surface default background hiding to a separately reviewed product change.

options.title: Wait for the Gateway contract
options.body: Keep this draft open until the upstream presentation fields and semantics merge, then refresh the parser, tests, and proof against the final contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the coordinated rollout
recommendation.body: Finalize the upstream contract, capture native Windows proof for new and older Gateways, and land the readable-title and default background-filtering behavior together.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa is coordinating both the canonical Windows report and the linked upstream presentation-contract work, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the decision.
